description.en-US: The channel this mapping permits a fulfillment method for. Immutable: moving a mapping between channels is disallowing it on one and allowing it on the other, and doing that as an update would skip the check that a channel's default method stays inside its own allowed set.

The method this channel may use. Unlike the payment-method mapping next door this one names a row in Sales itself, so it carries a real edge: the constraint costs nothing across a module boundary and stops a mapping pointing at a method that never existed.
